current_user_query: My doctor told me last week that I have high blood pressure, around 155 over 95.

relations: Blood_Pressure_Systolic and Blood_Pressure_Diastolic together define the current elevated blood pressure reading.
Has_High_Blood_Pressure is set to 1 based on the elevated systolic and diastolic values.
Age (47) and Weight (102 kg) are known risk factors that can contribute to hypertension.
inferences: The user’s recent measurement (155/95 mmHg) meets criteria for stage 2 hypertension.
Given the user's age and weight, lifestyle factors may be influencing blood pressure.

task.description: Seek hypertension evaluation: confirm diagnosis and discuss treatment options for systolic BP ≥140 mmHg.
Provide guidance on interpreting blood pressure results and suggest personalized lifestyle changes (e.g., diet, exercise, sodium reduction) to help manage high blood pressure.
